title: Adaptive Learning
wikitext:
== Overview ==
'''Adaptive Learning''' is an AI-powered personalization engine that dynamically adjusts learning content difficulty and recommendations based on individual student performance.

== Features ==
=== Student Profiling ===
* Initial assessment
* Learning style detection
* Continuous profiling

=== Content Adjustment ===
* Dynamic difficulty scaling
* Learning path adaptation
* Intelligent recommendations

== ML Models ==
* Bayesian Knowledge Tracing (BKT)
* Deep Knowledge Tracing (DKT)
* Item Response Theory (IRT)
* Collaborative Filtering

== See Also ==
* [[Course Platform]]
* [[Learning Analytics]]
